reasons.claim: The chain is a single line from Mahmud to the Companion, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: سمعت ربعيا، يحدث عن أبي بكرة، قال قال رسول الله

reviews.question: An Imam speaking in a report with no transmitter (the compiler's own statement of what the Imam saw and said).

reasons.claim: No transmitter stands before Ali; he is the one who speaks the saying, so the readers' single link is the speaker.
reasons.quote: وَ رَأَى عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَسْجِداً

reasons.claim: The stored chain holds words that are not a name.
reasons.quote: و رأى علي مسجدا بالكوفة قد شرف

reviews.uncertainty_note: Whether a transmitter-less Imam statement is stored as a one-link chain or as no chain is not ruled.

reasons.claim: The brother is one link written by his name, and the gap is an unnamed link before the Imam.
reasons.quote: عن أخيه أحمد، عن محمد بن عبد الله بن مروان، عن ابن أبي عمير، عن بعض أصحابه، عن أبي عبد الله

reasons.claim: The unnamed aunt heard by al-Qasim is the one who quotes the Prophet and is the last link.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت عمتي، تقول قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: Ali is asked and answers in the words after the chain, so he is the last link after the bare relation.
reasons.quote: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ سُئِلَ

reasons.claim: The stored chain wrongly ends with words of the question.
Abd al-Azim is a link the stored chain dropped; the remark on his illness is no link.
reasons.quote: حَدَّثَنِی عَبْدُ الْعَظِیمِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَ کَانَ مَرِیضاً عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ

reasons.claim: Isa speaks to the Imam, who answers, so the Imam is the last link.
Ibn Abbas is heard and answers; the unnamed asker of the passive question is no link.
reasons.quote: قال سمعت ابن عباس، قيل له

reasons.claim: Each father named after «أبي» is one link, and the chain closes at the last named father who relays the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عَن أَبِيهِ‏أَبي طالِب‏ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The first bare father after Isma'il is a relation link before the Imam.
The two shaykhs share one level joined by «جميعا» at Ibn Uyayna.
reasons.quote: حدثني عمرو الناقد، وزهير بن حرب، جميعا عن ابن عيينة

reasons.claim: The dashed clause only gives Amr's wording for the same position, not an added link, so the stored chain's extra «سفيان» is wrong.
A second isnad for the same saying opens with al-Layth before the matn and is its own route.
reasons.quote: وقال الليث حدثني يونس عن ابن شهاب قال أخبرني عروة بن الزبير أنه سأل عائشة

reasons.claim: Aisha answers Urwa's question and is the last link of both routes.
